description: Read-only status lookup for a single trade created by place_trade. Pass the place_trade actionId returned by the approval request, or the deterministic singleTradeBotId/managerBotId single-trade-<actionId>. Includes the Lambda request id, execution timings and sanitized errors. The tool verifies the action belongs to the signed-in user, then returns approval and one-shot execution state plus a fresh same-account broker-order observation when the order id is known. Check brokerOrderRead and singleTradeResultSource; a submission receipt alone cannot establish current fill state.
name: get_single_trade_status
title: Check single-trade execution status
